is_anomaly.description: True if the event does not match a known healthy pattern or is a verified failure.

root_cause_analysis.description: A 2-3 sentence summary of the primary reason for the incident.

detected_errors.description: Specific error codes or log snippets identified as relevant.

remediation_steps.description: Step-by-step instructions for the DBA to resolve the issue.

confidence_score.description: The model's self-assessed certainty of this diagnosis.
